g.text: Disinfection depends on the residual history and the effective contact time

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Synthetic first-order disinfectant decay and ideal Chick–Watson exponent1 with kI=0.20 L/(mg·min). A parcel follows one assigned contact history; real
basins have residence-time distributions. Regulatory CT credit uses applicable residual/contact conventions and organism-specific criteria, not this
example curve. Demand, pH, temperature, and byproducts are omitted.
